about_the_game:
Knockless is a tactical, betrayal-filled social deduction game for 2-6 players set in a large carnival. Each round, a hidden Jester is chosen; this player sabotages others and cunningly plays to eliminate survivors one by one. The innocents must work together to complete tasks and uncover who the Jester is.

With its colorful yet tense atmosphere, Knockless offers a fun and strategic challenge you can enjoy with your friends.

The doors are locked, and you can trust no one because everyone is suspicious…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3330 3.0 GHz, AMD FX-8300 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760, Radeon R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Stereo. Play with good stereo.

short_description: Who can you trust at the carnival? In this colorful yet tense team-based social deduction game, one player becomes the hidden Jester each round. While the innocents work together to survive, the Jester uses sabotage and cunning to eliminate them one by one. Trust no one everyone is suspicious!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
